deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo dmidecode -t 41 2>/dev/null | grep -iA1 \"Onboard Device Type\""
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL raw `dmidecode -t 41` output filtered to the `Onboard Device Type` value for that section (raw text, verbatim) so the user can diff against expected; judge correctness/persistence after reboot.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; locates text but omits raw status/type bit separation, fixed length and LAN identity.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds bitfield/BDF validation but lowers capability for inputs.

original_test_intent: Validate the Type 41 Device Type byte for each onboard LAN record by separating enabled status from the 7-bit device class, binding both to the correct BDF and confirming stability after reboot.
original_method: Validate Type 41 length, retain/decode the raw Device Type byte, compare bit 7 and bits 6:0 with the approved LAN inventory/status/type policy and read-only PCI state, then repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user supplies expected enabled/type mappings and approves reboot; no LAN state toggle is required or allowed.
required_inputs: Expected enabled state and 7-bit Type 41 code per onboard LAN BDF
Approved reboot and recovery path independent of tested LAN
safety_requirements: Do not enable/disable, reset, bind/unbind, reconfigure or flash LAN hardware.
Preserve the raw byte and decode status/type independently.
Correlate the same record to a stable BDF before comparing PCI visibility.
Stop on network/management recovery failure; do not auto-retry reboot.
agent_execution_scope: Validate record length, decode raw status/type bits, map each record to its approved LAN/PCI identity and compare pre/post reboot.
Report invalid/reserved type, unexpected disabled status, mismatch or drift without issuing PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve per-LAN enabled/type policy, enum exceptions and reboot plan.
Interpret intentionally disabled/hidden devices and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep cannot prove byte offset/length, separate status from type, or identify the owning LAN function.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive raw/decoded Type 41 and PCI inventory; emit handle/BDF/raw byte/enabled bit/type code/expected mapping and pre/post result.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The onboard-LAN Device Type scope, script and 5/5-minute values remain; no state change is introduced.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Length-check Type 41, decode bit 7 separately from bits 6:0, bind the byte to designation/instance/BDF and compare with the approved LAN/PCI status/type map across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems publishing Type 41 records for onboard LAN.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, board/BIOS, parser/dmidecode, kernel and PCI utility versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 41 Device Type status/type bit definitions and PCI-address fields.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw bit masks, record identity and PCI correlation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects right class on wrong device, status/type conflation, reserved codes and reboot identity drift.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: PCI absence may follow an approved disabled state; visibility alone does not determine the SMBIOS enabled-bit verdict.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define deliberately disabled onboard LAN instances and applicable class codes, but cannot authorize toggling them during this metadata case.
expected_evidence: Approved LAN designation/instance/BDF, enabled and type-code map
Complete pre-reboot Type 41 handles/lengths and raw Device Type bytes
Per-record decoded status/type plus read-only PCI correlation
Statement that no LAN/driver/firmware state changed
Approved reboot/network/OOB record and post-reboot diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Onboard Device Type is a defined Type 41 bitfield; the LAN-specific expected map is a project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Bit decode and identity/PCI comparison are fully automatable after approved inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw status/type bit separation, length and BDF ownership.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains no-toggle safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates status/type inputs and engineer verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Prevents accepting a correct-looking Ethernet class when its enabled bit or LAN/BDF ownership is wrong.
independent_technical_reasoning: The byte encodes two distinct assertions—state and device class—whose correctness must be evaluated for one stable onboard LAN identity.
